findings.finding: Sub-out mute trip follows Q12 Vbe x 6.45 (-13 mV/C): SUB_MUTE 1.0 V at +5V 4.86 V (-20 C, hFE 60, R tol 2 %), 4.56 (0 C), 3.94 (25 C), 3.22-3.33 (70 C); fully on (3.5 V) only at 2.94-2.97 V hot. Hot, the mute relies on the ES8388 holding LOUT2 at VMID down to AVDD ~2 V. Worst part (JSCJ 2N7002 Vth 2.5 V, Rds 7 ohm max x1.4 hot): -62 mV in a 20-80 Hz band vs -0.60 V unmuted (-20 dB; typical -6 mV, -40 dB). With round 2's premise (LOUT2 moves at +5V 3.4 V) and a slow +5V fall at 70 C: -0.57 V, mute ineffective.
findings.evidence: docs/review-4/sims/pad/mute/tb_trip_*.cir, tb_loss_*.cir (run.sh); JSCJ 2N7002 LCSC C8545 datasheet (Vth 1/1.6/2.5 V, Rds 1.1/7 ohm at 5 V); ES8388 DS rev 5.0 AVDD 1.7-3.6 V
findings.reference_design: DIY TPA3118 supply-sense mutes (pedalpcb, diyaudio 379831) use a zener/transistor sense with the same trip-vs-supply trade; a voltage detector IC is temperature-flat
findings.fix: R36/R38 100R -> 470R 0603 (LCSC C23179, verify; also R3-SYSTEM-7 ESD fix): worst corner -33 mV (-25 dB). Bring-up: unplug after 30 min loud (box ~60 C), scope SUB_L and +5V, record +5V where LOUT2 leaves 1.65 V. Next spin if it moves above +5V ~3 V: 4.0 V open-drain voltage detector in place of Q12/R80/R81.
findings.margin: normal op: mute <= 0.14 V vs Vth min 1.0 V at all corners; hot: full mute at 2.94 V vs LOUT2 hold to ~2.0 V (assumed): 0.9 V

findings.finding: VBUS capacitance at attach 15.8 uF nominal (~13 uF at 5 V) vs Type-C cSnkBulk 10 uF; with Q1 on, 706 uF on VBUS vs PD cSnkBulkPd 100 uF (also via Q1 body diode on negative transitions/hard reset). Lite is immune to the field failure (bulk behind a PG-gated soft-start switch) but is out of spec.
findings.reference_design: #202's proposed fix is exactly Lite's Q1 + PG; TPS54302 table 7-2 input 10 uF + 0.1 uF
findings.fix: None required. Bring-up: 20 attaches each on Apple 30 W and 96/140 W and an Anker multi-port, plus a second device plugged into the multi-port while playing. Contingency: DNP C4.

findings.finding: squeezelite DAC_CONTROLSET (HIFI_LITE) writes LOUT2/ROUT2 = 30 (0 dB) and LOUT1/ROUT1 = 28; SUB_CODE_MAX 26 lands 2 s later in codec_apply(). A 0 dBFS sub in that window swings 1.41 Vpk, past the mute FETs' -Vth (1.0 V min): clipped negative half.
findings.evidence: firmware/patches/0001 DAC_CONTROLSET reg 48/49 val 30; board_lite.c hifi_bsp_route() 2000 ms; docs/review-3/sims/fix/lite_mute/tb_play_0dB_info
findings.fix: patches/0001 DAC_CONTROLSET HIFI_LITE: reg 48/49 val 26, reg 46/47 val 27.

findings.fix: Document; R4-PAD-1 detector contingency removes it.

findings.finding: Power-up not covered: mute releases at +5V ~3.9 V, the ES8388 starts seconds later; VMID ramp (tau 0.25 s) gives a 0.31 V sub-sonic bump, 16 mV in 20-80 Hz (-31 dB vs the unmuted unplug thump).

DJ-direct is analog and bypasses hifi_gov_process(): no power/thermal governor. Bounded now by the analog caps (5.4 Vrms = 7.3 W/ch into 4 ohm, 14.6 W < 18 W thermal cap). R3-AUDIO-4's raise to 10.9 Vrms (29.7 W/ch) would exceed both thermal and contract limits ungoverned.
findings.evidence: hifi_main.c l.935 (governor on squeezelite samples only); board_lite.c codec_apply DJ branch
findings.fix: Cap DJ-direct at <= 6.0 Vrms (9 W/ch into 4 ohm) unless it gets a governor.

findings.finding: At SUB_CODE_MAX the sub swings -0.71 Vpk vs 2N7002 Vth min 1.0 V (25 C), ~0.82 V at 70 C: 0.11 V; sub-threshold leakage est. <= 20 uA into 100R, <= 0.3 % on the worst part hot.
